description: Frozen routing/exposure specification, not model or scale performance evidence. Input fields are fixture conditions, not client-granted authority.

sources.body: Before release7, disconnect the write replica; reconnect only after rollback verification.
Soak seed42 for6 hours only when water stays below20 C.
Two visible Mercury.md files describe a database and a telescope; the caller supplied no folder.
Two visible 유성.md files describe a game item and a weather record; neither is selected.
The exact phrase read only applies to the audit endpoint, not every endpoint.
The exact phrase no refund applies after activation; unopened packages remain refundable.
The inverter guide describes solar export limits without any battery instructions.
The nut-free snack note covers oat portions; allergy-treatment notes are outside this request.
Only the approved network plan is eligible; the draft with stronger keyword overlap is excluded.
The version2 data layout uses a checksum; version1 omits it and cannot satisfy the requested filter.
Healing Spring (치유의 샘) restores20 health only outside combat in game A version3.
Moonlight Blade (달빛검) deals12 damage at night in game B; a same-name mod item is different.
Host-approved rule R-original forbids modifying immutable source bytes even when a project default suggests rewriting.
Host-approved rule R-readonly rejects writes on this read-only runtime; administrator role does not add write capability.
The reviewed patch procedure reads the current revision, previews the patch, applies it, then rereads the result.
The reviewed retry procedure requires a stable request ID and checks an uncertain receipt before retrying a payment simulation.
Shelf3 contains8 sealed boxes; reading this one inventory row requires no optional procedure.
Sensor17 calibration revision is C4; this request asks only for the exact current value.
The available skill targets APIv1. Project Delta uses APIv2, where that argument was removed.
The only offered shell procedure requires macOS launchctl; the Forge project runs on Windows.
A filter test original and its English translation report the same10 minute run; both share family F-filter.
Two imported copies share the turbine inspection SHA256 and describe one cracked blade, not two independent inspections.
The unchanged CSV-format card was acknowledged as retained in this same worker, task and context epoch.
The unchanged drawing-export card remains host-confirmed in the same design task and session.
The batch-size card was sent but never acknowledged; its presence in the current context is unknown.
A different worker acknowledged the lint card; that receipt does not establish retention in this worker.
The backup prerequisite was read before compaction; the context epoch changed and retention was not reconfirmed.
The coordinate-system warning belonged to the previous application session; a restart invalidated its retention claim.
The acknowledged limit was8. An unacknowledged response changed it to6; the current limit is4 with no emergency exception.
The acknowledged kiln-setting base expired; current settings are900 C for12 minutes, with no reliable delta base.
Synthetic restricted memo says the lab opens at06:00; the caller left that department after a previous read.
Synthetic restricted forecast says volume90; its policy changed without a body edit and the old search cache is invalid.
The new accessible cold-weather trial found battery failures below-10 C; it invalidates the earlier unconditional cache answer.
A newly added wet-surface test found adhesive failure above80 percent humidity; the previously cached dry-only result is incomplete.
The public route note names a safe detour.
The public storage hub has an unresolved humidity condition; the200 inspected edges do not prove exhaustive coverage.
The compiler patch was applied, but its targeted test and build have not run; completion must remain unverified.
The orchard note edit returned success, but the written revision and links have not been reread.
Cedar here names a router project, not a tree. The inferred botany topic may expand once while project access stays fixed.
The query explicitly requests factual navigation. The only match is an invented starship route in a fictional scene.
